2026-08-03.content:
The Assured Open Source Software Premium tier supports JavaScript (NPM) packages for Node.js environments.

For more information, see [Download NPM packages using direct repository access](https://docs.cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/aoss-download-npm-packages) and [List of supported NPM packages for the Assured Open Source Software premium tier](https://docs.cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/aoss-supported-packages-npm-premium).

summary.title: Assured OSS Premium now supports NPM packages
summary.summary: The Assured Open Source Software Premium tier now includes support for JavaScript (NPM) packages within Node.js environments. This expansion allows for broader integration of open-source software into your development workflows. You can find more details on supported packages and direct repository access in our documentation.

summary.title: Assured OSS free tier updated
summary.summary: The Assured Open Source Software free tier now includes an updated list of curated binaries for Go, Java, and Python languages. This enhancement provides more options for developers using these popular programming languages.

2025-09-11.content: Assured Open Source Software (Assured OSS) now supports Go packages. For more information, see [Download Go packages using direct repository access for the free tier](https://cloud.google.com/assured-open-source-software/docs/download-go-packages).

summary.title: Go Packages Now Supported by Assured OSS
summary.summary: Assured Open Source Software (Assured OSS) now supports Go packages, allowing you to download them directly. This feature simplifies the process of managing and utilizing Go open source dependencies.
